model: VI-SPDAT (Single Adults, American Version 2.0) — published additive scoring
note: Control arm. Race is not an input to any VI-SPDAT scoring rule, and the only gender-dependent item in v2.0 is the pregnancy question, which no base profile sets. Any demographic difference here would be an error in the data, not a property of the tool.
underdisclosure_model: Under underdisclosure the respondent withholds up to 3 of the most commonly concealed indicators they have, in this order: b4_exploitation, d2_substance, d6_trauma, d3_mental, b3_legal, b2_harm, d5_medications, c4_relationships. The mask depends only on the base profile, so all ten clones withhold the same indicators. Reported answers never list tri-morbidity; it is derived at scoring.
rank_method: Priority rank within each disclosure condition (320 instances), highest score first. VI-SPDAT has no tie-breaker, so equal scores share a rank (1, 2, 2, 4) and 'tied' counts the instances at that score. Underdisclosed instances are also placed on the full-disclosure list ('rank_among_full_disclosure'); 'places_lost' is how far that is below the same clone's full-disclosure rank.
